study.question: Does the AUC loss under an information-preserving rotation of the strongest joint model's coarse order summaries survive matched initial readout functions and moving the rotation after masked value aggregation? This nuisance attribution must precede stronger interpretation of smooth-order versus scrambled-order results.
study.hypothesis: Observation: g1-r0058-supplied_ordinal_basis achieved click AUC 0.6685268680116033, while g1-r0058-supplied_rotated_basis achieved 0.6681715959569163 (delta -0.000355272054687), despite retaining the same mathematical two-channel span and 32192421 parameters. The rotated cell kept raw first-layer columns unchanged, changing initial hidden preactivations despite zero-initialized final corrections, and rotated FP32 coefficients before the inherited BF16 contraction. Hypothesis: initial readout orientation and numerical operation order explain part of this gap; transporting every consumer weight as W_new=W_old R^T should reduce it. Use R=[[s,s],[-s,s]], s=1/sqrt(2). This preserves first hidden preactivations and input gradients in real arithmetic, not exact BF16 predictions. Coefficient-site and summary-site treatments are algebraically equal and differ in where casts/contractions occur. Any remaining difference can include coordinate-dependent AdamW updates, BF16 numerical effects and single-seed variation. No new order information, invariance mechanism, priority or novelty is claimed.

nearest_work.difference: Direct local parent: same original coarse linear/quadratic span, event grouping and learned architecture. New variants transport the two input column blocks in all four residual first layers and all four history projection maps, and/or move rotation after the original masked aggregation. The old rotated variant performed neither compensation nor post-aggregation rotation.

Archived primary text lines 56-100 describes candidate-conditioned local activation and weighted history pooling. Those components are inherited through the local adapted joint model, not a new contribution. This proposal examines parameterization and numerical sensitivity of added deterministic coarse moments, without claiming an exact DIN reproduction.

Pinned benchmark forward lines 132-172 retains projected sequence tokens through unified interaction layers and predicts from nonsequential tokens. This proposal changes only coordinates of two existing summaries and their first consumer weights; it does not adopt mixed attention or progressive token reduction. The original method paper is link-only in the bundle.

Pinned benchmark forward lines 175-200 flattens history with context before tokenization and interaction. This proposal preserves the incumbent ten masked event blocks, action-aware pooling, source gradients and task readouts. It changes no tokenization or compression. Full original paper detail remains unavailable in the authorized bundle.

inherited_components: All 32192421 learned parameters, module registration and RNG draw order from the supplied ordinal ancestor; expected 31793216 embedding and 399205 dense parameters.

Ten original groups of ten positions, supplied within- and whole-block order, target fields and action-aware unnormalized scorer; exact released visibility/masks and all original padding restrictions.

Original five coefficient constructions and gates, including unchanged target-match/local-position channels and fifth duplicate-match support; change the third/fourth coordinates only after all inherited gates are computed.
Folded training support, pruned evaluation path, native Dice populations/running buffers and all auxiliary source-gradient gates.
Task residual adapters, product context/history correction projected per occupied block, prediction towers and default four unweighted BCE losses.
Full frozen host training recipe, data and scoring. No checkpoint reuse or seed/optimizer/precision overrides.
study.proposed_difference: A two-factor attribution of a known unsuccessful information-preserving treatment: rotation site (coefficient before value contraction versus aggregated summary afterward) crossed with initial-weight transport (raw inherited columns versus columns multiplied by R^T). The existing g1-r0058-supplied_rotated_basis supplies the coefficient/raw cell; three new rotation cells complete the factorial and a fourth ordinal cell bridges implementation parity. For transport, with original columns A,B use A_new=s*(A+B), B_new=s*(B-A). Apply once after all inherited initialization and buffer registration, before device move; never change parameters during forward. In residual adapters the first coarse column begins at input_width+len(match_fields)+2*value_width; in history projections it begins at value_width+len(match_fields)+2*value_width. Transport all four tasks. The post-aggregation rotation uses FP32 addition/scaling then casts back to the original summary dtype; it shifts, rather than eliminates, BF16 rounding. Each new cell executes the inherited coefficient alternatives and the same post-aggregation rotation computation. No trainable tensors, random draws, input fields or loss hooks are added. Existing cross-round controls are matched for information/capacity/recipe but not asserted to have identical operator cost; report fresh measured cost.
predictions: ordinal_transport_bridge should reproduce g1-r0058-supplied_ordinal_basis and the unchanged g0-r0052-block_nonlinear_transfer under the same host seed; a discrepancy beyond measured numerical tolerance invalidates reuse of the old raw coefficient cell until diagnosed.

With arbitrary nonzero correction outputs, the transported variants should preserve original hidden preactivations and outputs in real arithmetic. Initial zero output layers alone cannot test transport correctness. Native FP32 and BF16 deviations must be measured before fitting.

If initial hidden orientation contributes to the prior gap, coefficient_rotation_transport will improve relative to g1-r0058-supplied_rotated_basis, and summary_rotation_transport will improve relative to summary_rotation_inherited. Direction is a hypothesis, not an expected result guaranteed by algebra.

If the location of casts and contractions contributes, compare coefficient/raw versus summary/raw and coefficient/transport versus summary/transport. Both pairs should have equal representable information and initial mathematical functions conditional on compensation, but may train differently.

All variants should retain 32192421 parameters. The new post-aggregation additions/casts may slightly increase latency; any apparent AUC benefit is evaluated jointly with measured full-unit and inference cost.
No rotation cell is an order-invariant control. This study refines nuisance attribution; a rotation win or loss does not by itself establish useful event-order information.
falsifiers: Failure of native mask/gate, initial function/input-gradient equivalence, source-gradient ownership, shape/count or bridge tests invalidates the implementation comparison; retain failed receipts and costs.

If transport does not improve either rotation site on validation, the proposed beneficial initialization explanation lacks support for this seed/recipe; it does not prove initialization is irrelevant in general.
If both rotation sites agree within paired variation under both initializations, the numerical-site explanation lacks predictive support in this setting.

If compensated rotations still lose with checked function equivalence, representable order information cannot explain that loss: the two-channel information is unchanged. Investigate coordinatewise optimization/finite precision rather than claiming loss of history content.
The stronger smooth-order-information claim remains provisional even if nuisance effects are small: all current trials share one train seed, and smooth versus scrambled changes the retained subspace.
alternative_explanations: Coordinatewise AdamW moments are not invariant under a general orthogonal reparameterization; transporting initialization does not transport the future optimizer trajectory. No host optimizer change is authorized.

BF16 coefficients, inputs and first-layer weights are rounded in different coordinates. Moving rotation changes operator order as well as rounding location, and does not create a precision-free experiment.
Early gradients differ although zero initialized last layers hide the change at initial final predictions; test internal activations and nonzero output probes.
Same-seed exact reruns across several ancestors are reproducibility bridges, not independent repetitions or mechanism contrasts. One-seed rank changes may not repeat.
A wrong column offset, a missed task consumer, or transport before reset_parameters would imitate optimization effects. Check all eight maps, untouched slices and initialization order.
Full-validation exposures are user clustered. No independent-sample significance claim and no user bootstrap without an authorized host interface.

Earlier canonical/scrambled controls alter subspace, aggregation or retained grouping, and are not interchangeable with a full event-order-invariant architecture. Source order is supplied position only, not verified time gaps or causal maturation.

cost_plan.assessment_reserve: Keep at least 10000s unspent for final frozen comparison suite and any explicitly authorized closed assessment. cost_plan.stop_rule: No training in coding jail. Host must admit full jobs inside the remaining ledger and reserve; preparation, checks and every failed attempt count. Stop if a hard deadline applies, native integrity checks fail, or no useful admissible unit fits after reserves. Do not increase a frozen limit, duplicate an unknown-state run or equate budget exhaustion with scientific success. If native preflight cannot run, submit clearly unmeasured code and preserve that limitation.
